You are resolving an in-progress git merge in treams-rs (branch claude/treams-rs-improvements-snetmh). It merges commit e807e46 (condensed into 8251007) ("RA1b": crates/treams-core/src/{angular.rs, waves.rs, translation_plan.rs} — Wigner 3j stability fix (upward recurrence through the forbidden region, direction from symbol ratios, mirror case), translation harmonics evaluated on the unit sphere (no NaN at tiny/huge/subnormal displacements), O(P^2) value-only harmonic tables, one radial sequence per table, contiguous plan terms, Wigner3jRow/Coupling, pullback_table contraction, removal of angular::angular, new exact symmetry proptests) into the integration branch, which already contains every other package: RA0 test layout, RA1a special functions, RA2 fields/linalg (field evaluation now has its own radial cache), RA3 particles/clusters, RB1 waves/coordinates/polar (its properties/waves.rs contains many new group-law/ladder properties), RB2 lattice, RB3 planar (smatrix split into submodules), all bindings lanes and the Python test lanes (mandatory category markers, strict xfails pinning known defects). Do not abort the merge.

Conflicts: crates/treams-core/src/properties/waves.rs, docs/status.md, tests/test_wigner.py (check git status).

Rules:

  • properties/waves.rs: keep BOTH sides' properties; adapt RA1b's tests and any HEAD test that used a removed/renamed API (e.g. angular::angular was removed by RA1b; RB1 or RA2 code/tests elsewhere may call it or other changed translation_plan/waves functions — grep the whole crate and the bindings crate for compile errors and port call sites to RA1b's replacement API, keeping behaviour).
  • Callers outside RA1b's files that the merge breaks (fields.rs, lattice.rs, basis.rs, tmatrix.rs, iterative.rs, polar.rs, treams-py bindings) must be ported to RA1b's API with identical results.
  • docs/status.md: keep both sides (additive); remove expected-failure entries RA1b fixed.
  • RA1b fixed defects that the Python test lane pinned as STRICT xfails (xfail_strict=true): the spherical-translation NaN when |d|^p underflows (tiny displacements, degree 6 at 6.5e-53, degree 10 at 1e-20) and the Wigner 3j accuracy loss in rotated argument orders / lower forbidden region (e.g. (15,15,23;15,-15,0), large j with extreme m). Run the full suite; every XPASS for a fixed defect must become a plain test (keep its assertions), and the docs/status.md 'expected failures' list must drop it. tests/test_wigner.py: keep the lane's structure/markers and RA1b's new pinned public wigner3j checks.
  • Every test needs a registered category marker (tests/test_suite_contract.py guard).
  • The parity battery isolates the INTENDED Wigner 3j change in cases named wigner3j_large_. Run PYTHONPATH=$PWD/python .venv/bin/python battery.py compare baseline.npz -v; failures are acceptable ONLY in wigner3j_large_ cases and only if the new values are closer to exact (verify a few against an exact reference, e.g. mpmath/sympy Wigner 3j via the venv's packages if available, or the Racah formula with Python fractions). Any other failing case must be investigated and fixed or explained precisely. Report the full list of changed cases with errors.

Verification (must all pass before committing, except the documented wigner3j_large_* parity deltas): cd treams-rs && just build-ext (warm or cold target), cargo fmt --check --all, PYO3_PYTHON=$PWD/.venv/bin/python cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, PYO3_PYTHON=$PWD/.venv/bin/python cargo test --locked -p treams-core, RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" PYO3_PYTHON=$PWD/.venv/bin/python cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --locked, .venv/bin/ruff format --check . && .venv/bin/ruff check ., uv run --no-sync pyrefly check, uv run --no-sync python scripts/generate_agent_docs.py --check (regenerate if needed), the full uv run --no-sync pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider, and the parity battery as above. Commit the merge with message "Merge RA1b: angular algebra, Wigner 3j and translation tables" plus a body describing resolutions, ported call sites, xfails converted and the parity deltas, ending with: Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com Claude-Session: [link to a conversation in the cloud] Do NOT push; do not touch scratch: lanes or other branches. Use a private scratch subdirectory under scratch for logs. Report resolutions and all verification results.

The RA1b merge is committed as 0b26b9a (condensed into 8251007) on claude/treams-rs-improvements-snetmh, with parents dfa70ab (condensed into 8251007) and e807e46 (condensed into 8251007). It is not pushed. Every verification step passes except one parity case, wigner3j_large_j100_30_m99_-30, and its new values are closer to the exact ones.

How the conflicts were resolved

  • crates/treams-core/src/properties/waves.rs: both translation-scale properties are kept.
    • HEAD's translation_scale_derivative_identity covers degrees below 5, complex k, every polarization pair, both polar half-axes, scale s = 1.3, at 1e-12.
    • RA1b's translation_scale_invariance_and_euler_identity covers degrees up to 40 and s = 10^e for |e| ≤ 12, at 1e-10.
    • They now share one check_translation_scale that takes the scale factor and tolerance. As a result both also check how the gradient and the k-derivative scale.
    • The harmonic ladder property now calls waves::harmonic with angular::direction(position), which is RA1b's new signature.
  • docs/status.md: kept HEAD's Legendre-near-poles note and RA1b's paragraphs on Wigner 3j and unit-sphere translations. RA1b says spherical field evaluation still returns NaN for outgoing lmax 40 at 1e-7; I reproduced that with the merged fields.rs, so the sentence stays.
  • tests/test_wigner.py: kept the lane's structure and markers, and RA1b's exact Racah tests (marked oracle_numerical). I dropped RA1b's copy of the Ewald test because HEAD already moved it to tests/test_integral_adjoints.py.

Call sites ported to RA1b's API

  • polar.rs tests: term_scale uses angular::on_sphere at the unit displacement instead of the removed angular::angular.
  • properties/special.rs (RA1b's new check_wigner_d): rotation::spherical(&basis, &basis, …), because since RB1 it takes borrowed bases. This was a compile error.
  • tests/test_invariants.py: the automatic merge placed RA1b's new unit-change property under the near-axis test's oracle_numerical marker, which left the near-axis test without one. I restored that marker and marked the new property physics.
  • Nothing else needed porting. fields.rs, lattice.rs, basis.rs, tmatrix.rs, iterative.rs and the bindings use solid, TranslationPlan and wigner3j, whose signatures did not change.

Strict xfails turned into plain tests

Both of these passed unexpectedly with RA1b; their assertions are kept:

  • test_translation.py::test_tiny_displacement_translation_is_continuous, the NaN when |d|^p underflows.
  • test_wigner.py::test_wigner3j_in_every_argument_order, including the rotated orders of (15 15 23; 15 −15 0).

docs/status.md drops both from the expected-failure list and now says "Four defects" instead of "Six". No other xfail passed unexpectedly.

One change goes beyond the conversion: the composition property in test_translation.py had avoided short displacements only because of this NaN. Its displacement components now go down to 1e-40 and subnormals, and it passed 400 extra examples.

Verification

full pytest 4335 passed, 36 skipped, 23 xfailed, no XPASS

Parity battery

Against the baseline, 127 of 128 cases pass. The one failure is wigner3j_large_j100_30_m99_-30 at 1.50e-10 element-wise. I checked it with a Racah formula in rational arithmetic, which agrees with SymPy:

  • (100 30 84; 99 −30 −69) is exactly −1.7231437394665956e-05.
  • The baseline gave −1.7231437397255197e-05, off by 1.5e-10 relative.
  • The merge gives −1.723143739466453e-05, off by 8e-14.
  • Across that row, the largest relative error drops from 1.50e-10 to 1.26e-13.

Every other wigner3j_large_* change also moves toward the exact values:

Case Parity delta Row max rel. error, baseline → merged
j100_100_m100_-100 (near-miss) 5.24e-11 5.23e-11 → 1.38e-13
j60_45_m30_-45 5.20e-13 4.81e-13 → 3.91e-14
j90_70_m85_-70 5.13e-13 6.19e-13 → 1.10e-13
j60_60_m±60_∓60 2.11e-13 1.93e-13 → 2.14e-14
scalar_extremes 2.75e-14 worst element closer to exact

To separate what this merge changed, I also built the pre-merge HEAD in /tmp and recorded the battery with it. Against that recording, the only non-Wigner case above rounding level is hot_scattered_fields_spherical_near_axes at 4.67e-12, and it passes.

  • Its translation tables differ by at most 1.06e-15 and the cluster coefficients by 1.1e-15.
  • Degree-5 outgoing waves at kr ≈ 0.6 amplify that. Earlier merges had already moved this case by 1.22e-12 from the baseline.
  • The other 29 changed translation, cluster, periodic and field cases differ by at most 7.3e-15.

The other near-miss, lattice_sums_spherical_generic at 2.18e-11, was already there before this merge; the merge does not change it.

Logs are in ra1b-merge/: parity2.log, diff-head-merged.log, pytest2.log and cargo-test.log. The Racah check script is exact_3j.py in the same folder.
